spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (कटति)
1 To go, to move.
2 To live with difficulty.
(इ) कटि (कण्टति)
To go.
(ए) कटे (कटति)
1 To rain.
2 To encompass, to cover or screen.
(ई) कटी (कटति)
To go or approach:
with प्र prefixed,
verb 10th cl. (प्रकटयति)
To appear, to become apparent or manifest.

mfn. (-टः-टी-टं)
An agent in any action.
mf. (-टः-टी)
1 The hip.
2 The hollow above the hip or the loins, also the hip and loins.
m. (-टः)
1 The temples of the elephant.
2 A mat.
3 A twist of straw or grass.
4 A screen of the same.
5 A corpse.
6 A time or season.
7 Much, excessive.
8

Grass.
9

A place where dead bodies are burnt or buried, a place of sepulture.
10 A hearse, a bier, a bed, &c. used for conveying a dead body.
11 An annual plant.
12 A thin piece of wood, a plank.
f. (-टी)
Long pepper.
E.
कट to rain or encompass, अच् affix, fem. ङीष्; also कटि.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 The side or ridge of a hill or mountain.
2 Table land.
3 Sea salt.
4 A ring placed as an ornament upon an elephant's tusk.
5 A bracelet of gold, shell, &c.
6 A zone.
7 A royal metropolis.
8 A city or town.
9 A village.
10 A house or dwelling.
11 A camp.
12 An army.
13 A circle.
14 A wheel.
E.
कट to encompass, कन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-की)
A mountain.
E.
कटक land on a hill, &c. and इनि aff.

m. (-लः)
A spitting vessel.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
An eater, one who eats voraciously.
m. (-कः)
1 A glass vessel, a tumbler or bowl.
2 A crow.
3 A jackall.
E.
कट much, or a corpse, खाद to eat, affix वुन्.

m. (-ठः)
A name of GAṆEŚA.
E.
कट a mat, &c. कट who goes, खच् aff.

Turmeric.
2
Yellow saunders.

n. (-नं)
Roof or thatch of a house.

m. (-नः)
A kind of goblin.

m. (-प्रूः)
1 A name of

MAHĀDEVA.
2
A kind of demigod, one of the class of

Vidyādharas.
3

A Rākṣasa, an imp or demon.
4 Gambling, playing with dice.
5 A worm.
E.
कट much, प्र to go, क्विप् affix, and the final is made long.

m. (-थः)
The buttocks: see कटिप्रोथ.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 Gleaning, plucking or gathering corn by the hand.
2 Royal misfortune, as deposure, defeat, &c.
E.
कट, &c. भञ्ज to break, अच् aff.

f. (-भी)
1 A plant, (Heartpea, Cardiaspermum halicacabum.)
2 Another creeper, (Clitoria ternata.)
E.
कट to encompass, and भज to serve, ड and ङीष् affs.

f. (-नी)
Wine or any vinous liquor.

m. (-म्बः)
1 A kind of musical instrument.
2 An arrow.
E.
कट to go, and अम्ब Uṇādi aff.

f. (-रा)
A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.
E.
कट to surround, अच् affix; what invests the body, as sickness; वृ to screen or defend, मुम् inserted, and अच् and टाप् affixes; also कटम्भरा.

f. (-रा)
1 A plant, (Poederia fetida.)
2 A medicinal plant, कटुकीः see the preceding.
3 A sort of cucumber, (Cucumis Madraspatanus.)
4 A female elephant.
5 Red arsenic.
6 A plant, (Aletris hyacinthoides): see मुर्व्वा.
7 Hog-weed.
E.
as before, भृ to nourish, &c.

m. (-णः)
A name of BHĪMASENA, one of the five Pāṇḍava brothers.
E.
कट much, व्रण who wounds.

f. (-रा)
A plant: see गाङ्गेष्टी.

n. (-लं)
1 The hip and loins.
2 An elephant's temples.
E.
कट, and स्थल place; also कटभू, &c.

m. (-कुः)
A bird.
E.
कट to go, काकु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-क्षः)
A leer, a glance or side look.
E.
कट to go, and अक्षि the eye.

n. (-णं)
Casting lewd or amorous glances, ogling.
E.
कटाक्ष a leer, and अवेक्षण looking.

m. (-ग्निः)
1 A fire of grass or straw.
2 Straw, &c. investing a criminal who is to be burnt and set on fire.
E.
कठ, and अग्नि fire.

n. (-नं)
A fragrant grass, (Andropogon muricatum.)

m. (-रः)
A libidinous man, a lecher.

m. (-रः)
A weapon, a dagger.

m. (-हः)
1 A shallow boiler for oil or butter.
2 A frying pan.
3 A winnowing basket.
4 A turtle's shell.
5 A young buffalo whose horns are just appearing.
6 A Dvīpa or division of the known continent, so called.
7 Hell, the infernal regions.
8 A well.
E.
कट much, &c. हन to destroy, with आङ् prefixed, and ड aff.

mf. (-टिः-टी)
1 The hip.
2 The buttocks.
3 An elephant's cheek.
E.
कट to go, कि affix, fem. ङीष्; see कट and कटिप्रोथ.

f. (-टी)
See कटि and कट.

n. (-टं)
The loins, the hip.
E.
कटि, and तट shore.

m. (-त्रः)
1 An ornament of small bells worn round the loins.
2 A cloth so worn.
3 Armour for the hip and loins.
E.
कटि the hip, and त्र what preserves, from त्रै with ड aff.

m. (-शः)
The loins.
E.
कटि and देश place.

mfn. (-टी-टिनी-टि)
1 Matted, screened.
2 Loined, having handsome loins, &c.
m. (-टी)
An elephant.
E.
कट an elephant's temples, &c. इनि pos. aff.

m. (-थः)
The buttocks.
E.
कटि the hip or loins, and प्रोथ to be equal to; also written कटप्रोथ, कटीप्रोथ, and severally कटि and प्रोथ.

m. (-कः)
The rider of an elephant, as distinct from the driver, the person that sits upon the loins.
E.
कटि the loins, रुह to mount, and वुञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
A species of the balsam apple, (Momordica charantia.)
E.
कट to go, &c. इल्ल affix कन् added; also कठिल्लक.

m. (-कः)
The hip and loins, or the hollow above the hip.
E.
कटि, शीर्ष the head or superior part, कन् aff.

f. (-ला)
A girdle of small bells.
E.
कटि the loins, and शृङ्खला a chain.

n. (-त्रं)
A female zone or waist-band.
E.
कटि the loins, and सूत्र a thread.

m. (-लः)
A crooked sword, a sabre or scymitar.

mn. (-रः-रं)
1 The cavity of the loins, or the iliac regions.
m. (-रः)
1 Mons veneris.
2 A cave.
E.
कट to go, and ईरन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
The posteriors.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-टुः-टुः or -ट्वी-टु)
1

Pungent.
2

Envious.
3

Fierce, impetuous, hot.
4

Fragrant.
5

Bad scented, ill smelling.
6 Displeasing, disagreeable.
m. (-टुः)
1 Pungency or a pungent taste.
2 A flower, (Michelia champaca.)
3

Camphor.
4

A sort of gourd, (Trichosanthes.)
n. (-टु)
1 An improper action, an act which ought not to have been done.
2 Blaming, reviling, scandal.
f. (-टुः)
1 The name of a medicinal plant; also कटुका and कटुकी.
2 A plant which bears a fragrant seed: see प्रियङ्गु.
3 Mustard.
E.
कट to go, &c. and उ Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः-की)
1 A plant, the bark and seed of which have an acrid and bitter taste, and are used in medicine for worms, dysentery, &c. (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
2 Gigantic swallow wort, (Colotropis gigantea.)
3 A fragrant kind of grass.
4

Mustard.
5

A gourd: see पटोल.
f. (-का or -की)
A medicinal plant, used as a sedative and laxative; also कटुरोहिणी.
n. (-कं)
A compound of three pungent substances, as black pepper, long pepper, and dry ginger: see त्रिकटु.
E.
कटु pungent, and कन् aff.

mn. (-न्दः-न्दं)
1 A plant, (Morunga guilandina, and Hyperanthera.)
2 Ginger, the fresh root or the plant.
3 Garlic.
E.
कटु, and कन्द a root; having a pungent root.

m. (-वुः)
A bitter gourd.
E.
कटुक pungent and acrid, अलावु a gourd.

m. (-टः)
A gnat or musquito.
E.
कटु, and कीट an insect.

m. (-कः)
A gnat or musquito.
E.
कटु fierce, and कीटक a worm.

m. (-णः)
A bird, jacana, (Parra goensis.)
E.
कटु disagreeable, क्वाण sound.

m. (-न्थिः)
Ginger, the root.
E.
कटु pungent, and ग्रन्थि joint.

m. (-दः)
The name of a plant; also तगर.
E.
कटु, and छद a leaf: having a pungent leaf.

f. (-ता)
1 Pungency, sharpness.
2 Testiness, irritability.
E.
कटु, and तल् affix; also with त्व, कटुत्वं.

f. (-का)
A bitter gourd.
E.
कटु, and तिक्त bitter, कन् affix with the fem. form.

f. (-म्बी)
See the preceding.
E.
कटु pungent, here meaning bitterly so, and तुम्बी a gourd.

n. (-यं)
The aggregate of three spices, ginger, and long and black pepper.
E.
कटु, and त्रय three.

m. (-वः)
Grain not inundated.
E.
कटु, and निष्प्लाव, non-inundation.

m. (-त्रः)
A medicinal plant, (Oldenlandia biflora.)
E.
कटु pungent, and पत्र leaf.

m. (-लः)
A sort of cucumber, (Trichosanthes dioeca.)
E.
कटु, and फल fruit.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Dried ginger.

n. (-द्रं)
Ginger either fresh or dry.
E.
कटु, and भद्र auspicious.

n. (-रं)
Buttermilk.
E.
कटु, and रा to give, affix ड.

n. (-वः)
A frog.
E.
कटु, and रव sound.

f. (-णी)
A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.
E.
कटु pungent, and रोहिणी that grows.

f. (-की)
A variety of solanum.
E.
कटु, and वार्त्ताकी the egg plant.

f. (-जा)
Long pepper.
E.
कटु, and वीज seed.

m. (-हः)
The mustard seed plant, (Sinapis dichotoma.)
E.
कटु, and स्नेह oily substance: yielding a pungent oil.

n. (-टं)
Ginger.
E.
कटु, and उत्कट best, and with कन् added कटूत्कटक.

f. (-रा)
A shallow cup.

m. (-लः)
A man of an inferior and degraded tribe, a Caṇḍāla, a Pariah, &c.
2 A pungent flavour.
E.
कट to go, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also कटोलक.

f. (-णा)
A kind of lute played by the common people.
E.
कटोल a Caṇḍāla, and वीणा a lute.

m. (-लः)
A small tree found in the north-west of Hindustan, the bark and seeds of which are used in medicine, and as aromatics; the fruit also is eaten; the common name is Kayaphal.
f. (-ला)
1 A plant, (Gmelina arborea, Rox.)
2 The egg plant, &c.
E.
कट् instead of कटु acrid, and फल fruit, fem. affix टाप्.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.)
2 A name of DILĪPA a king of Ayodhya.
E.
कटु pungent, &c. अङ्ग bark, body, &c.

n. (-रं)
1 Sauce, condiment.
2

Buttermilk.
3

The skim or whey of curds.
E.
कट to rain, &c. वरच् aff.
